# Design of Control and Safety Valves

This tool assists in the sizing and dimensions of control valves & equipment in steam and condensate systems.

## Features:
- Valve sizing calculations
- Pressure drop analysis
- Flow rate determination
- Equipment dimensioning

Enter your system parameters below to generate sizing recommendations.
